description:
What the ruler wants for the coming years. Every field has a safe default: an empty plan
is a realm that grows and defends itself.

army.description: defend: no new wars on other courts; take only independent land and win back what was taken; build_up: raise more regiments, and take the provinces in `conquer` too; conquer: take what can be taken, and make war on `war_on`, seeking peace on every other front
army.title: Army

befriend.description: courts to seek an alliance (then a marriage) with
befriend.title: Befriend

conquer.description: provinces to take first, best first
conquer.title: Conquer

economy.description: grow: spend on development and works; balanced: as the bot judges; save: keep a war chest of about 150 ducats and spend little
economy.title: Economy

note.description: why, in a line: kept in the ruler's private thoughts
note.title: Note

peace_with.description: courts to make peace with if at war, and never to attack
peace_with.title: Peace With

research.description: technology branches in the order to study them
research.title: Research

war_on.description: a court to make war on as soon as the army is ready (with army=conquer); never one the realm has a treaty with

title: Plan
